versions.changelog:
- Initial release of Smell Source Detective.
- Diagnose mystery household odors by smell type, location, and timing; provides ranked source hypotheses with checks and fixes.
- Separates four urgent, dangerous smell patterns (gas, smoke, sewage backup, dead animal) from routine nuisances.
- Step-by-step, no-tools protocol to localize odor source (sniff-mapping, dry-trap tests, fixture-by-fixture checks).
- Includes detailed, source-specific elimination methods and decision lines for DIY vs. professional help.
- Built-in episode log to track patterns and support documentation for tenants/landlords.
- Pure Python, offline use; no external dependencies.
